@Sofia, the only figures I can find for Saltmarsh are the two Bettina posted in #coastal-team on Nov 17. At 14:19 she wrote "the Saltmarsh Provisions discount is 12% now," then at 14:24 she wrote "please ignore my earlier note, it's 10%," and said she had misread a draft worksheet from June Osei-Lark. Nothing in the share I can read (the public Coastal files or the knowledge brain) has a signed contract, order form, or amendment that settles it, so I can't confirm which number is final. The 10% correction is the one that matches the Coastal cheat sheet's note that discounts above 10% need Anselm's approval, but that doesn't prove it.

For the renewal brief, please get the executed order form or amendment from June Osei-Lark on the deal desk, since she owns the discount paperwork. If you'd like, I can DM June on your behalf to ask her to confirm the figure.
